title: Airdropper for GitHub Contributors
tagline: Airdropper for Github contributors is a SuperFluid-based dApp that simplifies reward distribution for open-source developers. With 2 UIs for admins & developers, it ensures fairness, transparency & incentivizes more contributions.
description:
The Airdropper for Github contributors is a decentralized application (dApp) that streamlines the reward distribution process for Github developers who contribute to open-source projects. The dApp is built using SuperFluid, which enables real-time, seamless, and frictionless payments.

The Airdropper for Github contributors consists of two user interfaces: one for developers and one for admins. The developer interface allows Github developers to register and link their Github accounts with their wallet addresses. Once their accounts are linked, developers become eligible to receive rewards for their contributions. The admin interface is for the Airdropper, who can distribute rewards to pre-registered accounts. The Airdropper can view the contributions made by developers and distribute rewards accordingly.

One of the key benefits of the Airdropper for Github contributors is that it ensures transparency and fairness in the distribution of rewards. Developers can view their contributions and rewards in real-time, while the Airdropper can distribute rewards based on the contributions made by each developer. This helps to incentivize developers to contribute more to open-source projects, which ultimately benefits the community.

In summary, the Airdropper for Github contributors is a powerful tool for streamlining the reward distribution process for Github developers who contribute to open-source projects. By simplifying the payment process, providing transparency and fairness, and leveraging SuperFluid technology, the Airdropper helps to incentivize and reward developers for their contributions to the open-source community.
how_its_made:
Technologically, Airdropper for Github contributors is built upon:

Frontend: The user interface is developed using JavaScript and HTML, delivering a responsive, user-friendly experience.
Smart Contracts: AFGC utilizes Solidity for creating secure, efficient, and transparent smart contracts to manage the reward distribution process.
Superfluid Integration: Superfluid technology is harnessed to facilitate instantaneous and continuous token airdrops, ensuring timely compensation for developer contributions.
Local Testing: The project employs scaffold-eth, a popular Ethereum development framework, to streamline local testing and accelerate the development process.
E2E Testing and Demo: AFGC utilizes the Mumbai testnet faucet for end-to-end testing and demonstrating the platform's functionality before deployment.
